@deskSetRecvMethodOnFailed.description: Toast title when turning a receiving method on failed. {method} is a method name such as Epicbox, HTTP or Tor.

@deskSetRecvMethodOffFailed.description: Toast title when turning a receiving method off failed. {method} is a method name such as Epicbox, HTTP or Tor.

@deskSetRecvServerNotChanged.description: Toast title when switching the Epicbox server failed.

@deskSetRecvReceiving.description: Settings > Receiving: title of the first row of each method group (the on/off switch).

@deskSetRecvSwitching.description: Screen reader label of the spinner while a receiving method is switched. {method} is Epicbox, HTTP or Tor.

@deskSetRecvMethodReceiving.description: Screen reader label of the switch for a receiving method. {method} is Epicbox, HTTP or Tor.

@deskSetRecvNotSaved.description: Toast title when saving a receiving setting failed.

@deskSetRecvAutostart.description: Settings > Receiving: row title of the switch that turns the method on at unlock.

@deskSetRecvAutostartHint.description: Settings > Receiving: hint under Start with the wallet.

@deskSetRecvMethodAutostart.description: Screen reader label of the Start with the wallet switch. {method} is Epicbox, HTTP or Tor.

@deskSetRecvHeadStopped.description: Settings > Receiving: state word at the right of a method group head when the method has stopped. Short.

@deskSetRecvHeadStarting.description: Settings > Receiving: state word at the right of a method group head while the method starts. Short.

deskSetRecvResponseTime: Response time {ms} ms. Measured from the status site.

@deskSetRecvResponseTime.description: Tooltip on an Epicbox server in the picker. {ms} is milliseconds.

@deskSetRecvEpicboxServer.description: Settings > Receiving: row title, picker label and screen reader name for the Epicbox server.

deskSetRecvEpicboxServerHint: Which server holds payments for this address. Both wallets can use different servers.

@deskSetRecvEpicboxServerHint.description: Settings > Receiving: hint under the Epicbox server row.

deskSetRecvFindHint: Find or type an Epicbox server

@deskSetRecvFindHint.description: Settings > Receiving: placeholder of the Epicbox server picker search field.

@deskSetRecvSwitchingServer.description: Settings > Receiving: shown while the Epicbox server is switched.

@deskSetRecvNotInList.description: Epicbox server picker: note on a typed server that is not in the public list. Lowercase.

deskSetRecvTypedNote: Enter uses it. Its status shows once the wallet connects.

deskSetRecvListNote: State from status.btlabs.uk, checked every few minutes.

@deskSetRecvHttpTitle.description: Settings > Receiving: heading of the HTTP group.

deskSetRecvHttpText: Straight from another wallet while this one is open.

@deskSetRecvHttpText.description: Settings > Receiving: text of the HTTP receiving row.

@deskSetRecvHttpOffTitle.description: Settings > Receiving: notice title in the HTTP group when Tor is on.

deskSetRecvHttpOffText: Direct payments arrive at this wallet’s Tor address instead.

@deskSetRecvHttpOffText.description: Settings > Receiving: notice text in the HTTP group when Tor is on.

@deskSetRecvPrivacySettings.description: Settings > Receiving: notice button that jumps to the Tor switch in Settings > Privacy.

@deskSetHttpNotChanged.description: Toast title when changing an HTTP receiving option failed. The error follows as text.

@deskSetHttpPortError.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: error under the port field.

@deskSetHttpReachable.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: row title for who can send payments to the HTTP address.

deskSetHttpReachableHint: Who can pay the HTTP address.

@deskSetHttpReachableHint.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: hint under the Reachable row.

@deskSetHttpLocalOnly.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: segment, only programs on this computer reach the address. Short.

@deskSetHttpFromInternet.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: segment, the address answers on the internet. Short.

deskSetHttpGuideHelp: Receive from the internet: how it works

@deskSetHttpGuideHelp.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the help button that opens the internet guide.

deskSetHttpPublicNote: Answers on all interfaces. The router must forward TCP {port} to this computer. Senders on the internet use http://<public IP>:{port}.

@deskSetHttpPublicNote.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: note under the Reachable row when From the internet is chosen. {port} is a port number; http://<public IP>:{port} is an address template and stays in this form.

@deskSetHttpPort.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: row title for the port number.

deskSetHttpPortHint: 1 to 65535. Used by the HTTP address.

@deskSetHttpPortHint.description: Settings > Receiving > HTTP: hint under the Port row.

@deskSetHttpPortLabel.description: Screen reader label of the port field.

@deskSetHttpGuideTitle.description: Internet guide dialog: title; also the primary button that turns it on.

@deskSetHttpGuideNowPublic.description: Internet guide dialog: description when the address is public.

deskSetHttpGuideNowLocal: Now: local only. Only programs on this computer reach the HTTP address.

@deskSetHttpGuideNowLocal.description: Internet guide dialog: description when the address is local only.

deskSetHttpStep1Text: The wallet answers on 0.0.0.0, port {port}. Other devices and the internet can then send payments to this wallet. The firewall may ask to allow it.

@deskSetHttpStep1Text.description: Internet guide dialog: step 1 text. 0.0.0.0 is an address and stays.

deskSetHttpStep2Text: On the router’s page (often 10.0.1.1), find Port forwarding and forward TCP {port} to this computer.
deskSetHttpStep3Text: Senders use http://<public IP>:{port}. The public IP can change.

@deskSetHttpStep3Text.description: Internet guide dialog: step 3 text. http://<public IP>:{port} is an address template and stays in this form.

@deskSetHttpNoRouter.description: Internet guide dialog: title of the Tor suggestion.

deskSetHttpNoRouterText: Tor works from anywhere with nothing to forward.

@deskSetHttpNoRouterText.description: Internet guide dialog: text of the Tor suggestion.

@deskSetHttpTurnOnTor.description: Internet guide dialog: small button that turns Tor receiving on.

deskSetHttpExposed: Only the receiving API is exposed. Plain HTTP is not encrypted.

@deskSetHttpExposed.description: Internet guide dialog: small note at the bottom.

@deskSetHttpBackLocal.description: Internet guide dialog: button that goes back to local only.
